summary: Frontend-only E2E test of PACZKA 12 part B (businesses) using Playwright at 1920x1080 and 375px. Most of it works: catalog filters and empty state, the public workshop page (buttons, address, map, hours with today highlighted, open-now badge, brands, AutoRepair JSON-LD), the dashboard tabs, stats and checklist, profile form (pin confirm toast, invalid postal code error toast), the driver access-code modal (code ZSZ-EXX in a valid format, QR, Kopiuj), workshop redeem in lowercase without the dash, the quick entry with translated types, the Wpisy list, the driver stamp with no edit/delete buttons, the notification, revoke and the 'Dostęp odebrany' state, the admin toggle and businesses columns/summary, the plan frame with 'Zapisano ✓', and EN for the dashboard and catalog. Found 3 functional bugs: (1) after a city search the URL drops ?miasto, so reloading does not restore the search; (2) the mobile Map view renders blank, with only one tile; (3) a race in catalog fetches can show the 46 unfiltered results instead of the city results.

minor.issue: Invalid postal code returns a raw Pydantic message 'Value error, postal_code must be 00-000 for PL', which the frontend shows as-is in English to PL users

ui_bugs.issue: Typing 'Kraków' and clicking catalog-city-search gives URL ?r=25 with no miasto. lookup() sets {miasto,r}, then the [point,radius,type] effect calls setParams(p => …) and overwrites it. In react-router v7 the functional updater gets the searchParams from the render closure, which do not have miasto yet. Result: reloading shows the empty input and all 46 businesses with no distance. Opening /warsztaty?miasto=Kraków&r=25 directly does work. Fix: build the params in one place, e.g. only set r inside lookup and skip the effect's setParams when a lookup just pushed, or use window.location.search / a ref.

At 375px, clicking catalog-view-map shows the Leaflet container with only one tile in the top-left corner and the rest blank. The map was created inside a display:none container and map.invalidateSize() is never called when the view changes. Fix: call invalidateSize on view change, e.g. a child using useMap with a setTimeout, or mount MapView only when it is visible.

fetchPage has no stale-response guard (no AbortController or request id). If the user searches before the first no-point fetch returns, the slower no-point response (46 items, no distance_km) overwrites the city result. Reproduced once on the first run. The first mount also sends the no-point search twice.

When a search returns 0 items (e.g. Suwałki at 5 km), the map does not move to the new point and stays on Kraków. FitBounds only runs when there are items, and the MapContainer center prop is ignored after mount. mapItems is also a new array on every render, so FitBounds resets the user's pan/zoom on any re-render, including each keystroke in the city input.

These strings are hardcoded in Polish and stay Polish in EN: 'Wszystkie warsztaty', 'Zweryfikowany', 'Specjalizacje', the TYPE_LABELS type name ('Warsztat') and the document title. WorkshopDetails below is translated correctly.

issues: 'Ważny do' uses toLocaleString() with the browser locale, giving US format 11/28/2026, 8:49 PM in the PL UI. Pass i18n.language.
The modal box starts at y=12, so a 12px strip of the page shows above the overlay. This suggests a transformed ancestor is affecting position:fixed. Consider a portal.
The workshop name appears twice: a '· QA Warsztat P11 99b8' line and then the stamp 'Potwierdzone przez QA Warsztat P11 99b8'.
Distance always uses the pl-PL format ('0,9 km') even in EN.
The checklist heading reads 'Profil gotowy' even when items are still open. Consider 'Gotowość profilu' or showing x/5.

The quick entry date uses a native <input type=date> (mm/dd/yyyy in en-US browsers) instead of the shadcn calendar. Default date comes from toISOString (UTC), so it can be yesterday between 00:00 and 01:00/02:00 PL time.
The code input placeholder 'np. ABC-DEF' inherits tracking-[0.3em] and looks odd.
'Odbierz dostęp' revokes immediately, with no confirmation.
The table is slightly wider than its container (1676 vs 1630px) and the last action button (NIP) is cut off without a visible scroll cue.
The list holds 178 'TEST P12 WS …' businesses created by backend pytest runs that never cleaned them up. The summary counters include them.
The NIP button's testid is admin-biz-shownip-*, not admin-biz-nip-* (that testid exists only on the NIP display).

action_items: Fix WorkshopList so ?miasto survives a city search (setParams race in the effect overwrites lookup's params)
Fix the mobile catalog map: call map.invalidateSize() when switching to the Map view (or mount it on demand)
Add a stale-response guard to WorkshopList.fetchPage (AbortController or request counter)
MapView: re-center on viewerCoords when there are 0 items; memoize mapItems so FitBounds does not reset the map on every render
Translate the hardcoded PL strings in WorkshopProfile.js (back link, Zweryfikowany, Specjalizacje, type labels, title)
Localize the backend postal-code validation message or map it to bizp.form.* on the frontend
Make tests/test_paczka12.py clean up the TEST P12 businesses/users it creates (178 leftovers visible in admin)

WorkshopList: no request cancellation; the fetch effect also runs a no-point search on mount even when ?miasto is present (wasted request plus race)
BusinessDashboard QuickEntry: date default uses UTC toISOString
VehicleWorkshopAccess: the QR object URL is revoked on close, but not if the component unmounts while the modal is open (minor leak)

rca of the issue: Bug 1 (miasto lost): lookup() calls setParams({miasto,r}), then setPoint triggers the effect, which calls setParams(p=>{n.set('r')}). The second navigation is computed from the pre-lookup searchParams, so miasto is dropped. Bug 2 (blank mobile map): Leaflet measures a 0x0 container under 'hidden' and never re-measures. Fix with invalidateSize.
